newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan economy needs structural reforms now -- JSDA.
newsitem.headline: Japan economy needs structural reforms now -- JSDA.

text.p: Drastic structural changes are needed now in Japan's economic and financial systems, in light of recent declines in Tokyo share prices, the chairman of the Japan Securities Dealers Association (JSDA) said on Thursday.
"I take the sharp falls in share prices at the end of last year and the beginning of this year seriously," Masashi Suzuki told a news conference.

"The declines, when companies' earnings are surely on a recovery trend, are because of the Japanese economy's structural problems and concerns over the future course of the economy. What is needed now is drastic structural reform of Japanese economic and financial systems," Suzuki said.

In order to revitalise the market, the securities industry should actively seek changes in securities transaction taxes, urge companies to purchase their own shares and promote venture companies, he said.
